Xeon Agents: A Field Guide

By A. Writer

Xeon is a layered runtime for conversational agents. Each layer has a narrow job, and a lower layer never reaches upward into a higher one. This guide walks through the layers from the contracts at the bottom to the applications at the top, and explains why the boundaries sit where they do.

Capabilities

Capabilities are typed service definitions. A web search capability, for instance, has one service method and one model tool. Providers are swappable: a self-hosted search engine, a paid API plugin, or the built-in wrapper around a hosted model tool. The front end applies policy, caching, and cost accounting around whichever provider answers, so every provider looks the same to the caller.
